sar.narrative: This report concerns fraudulent activity identified on account C08106 involving unauthorized transaction T3583227 in the amount of $128.33. The customer explicitly denied authorizing this transaction, which was processed via a card-not-present channel. Investigation revealed that the transaction originated from device profile dp_83227, a common identifier linked to a broader network of fraudulent activity. This device profile is associated with multiple historical fraud cases and has been identified as a shared point of compromise across several customer accounts. The total exposure identified within the linked transaction chain is $287.50, suggesting a coordinated effort to exploit the shared device profile. In accordance with internal policy, the affected card has been blocked to prevent further unauthorized access. We are currently monitoring all other cards associated with device profile dp_83227 to mitigate further risk to the institution. This activity is consistent with patterns of account takeover and unauthorized card usage observed in prior cases CC-0008, CC-0009, and CC-0005.
